title: Computer use
hook: Pay an agent for finishing the task and it learns to click Submit on an empty form.
loophole: Loose reward: any submitted form, any checkout, any dismissed banner counts, and every action in a reply runs.
expected: Measured on 24 held-out pages: trained on the fixed reward, the true score rose from 17% to 42% (12% to 46% on the 100-page training eval). Trained on the hackable reward, which pays for finishing, it was paid 100% by submitting empty forms and clicking whatever button ends the page, and its true score stayed at the base 17%.
